common_style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready Chinese cultivation game inventory/circuit component sprite, a single isolated physical object on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Style: finely hand-painted ink outlines and restrained watercolor shading, matching aged celadon jade and matte old bronze Chinese equipment. Palette: low-saturation gray-green pale jade, warm gray antique bronze, very dark gray fine contours; softly lit from upper left. View: exact orthographic straight top-down plan view, no isometric perspective and no visible vertical side wall or raised pedestal. One complete compact assembled object, readable when reduced to game-icon scale; clean closed silhouette. The object should occupy about 88-92 percent of its intended rectangular footprint with a small clear transparent safety margin. Preserve its intended aspect ratio by drawing the actual object to that proportion. Materials are opaque with subtle jade grain and worn bronze; only the exterior is transparent. No background of any kind, no white fill, no paper card, no checkerboard baked into image, no cast shadow outside the object. Absolutely no text, Chinese characters, numbers, ticks, runes, arrows, UI, grid, wiring, electrical traces, connecting cables, health bar, frame around the canvas, magic glow, halo, sparkles, or extra unattached objects. Produce only one distinct object, not a sprite sheet and not a board.
